description: Conducting remaining development activities of the Kelaniya Vidyalankara International Buddhist Conference Hall
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Vidyalankara International Buddhist Conference Hall building has been constructed as a sponsorship contribution by the Government for the national, religious, social and educational mission carried out by the Vidyalankara Pirivena in this country. Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑06‑23 to provide an amount of Rs.137.11 million for the year 2025, to restore the electric system of the said building. The restoration works of the electric system by the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, utilizing the said amount, is nearing completion, and it has been reported that there is a balance of the provisions allocated for that work. The proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to complete all other essential components of the said building, including the fire extinguisher system, air conditioner system, construction of the security fence, within this year by managing the balance provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.
